subject: Bench arm: match production judge-timeout semantics (retry + keep-provisional + count, NOT prune)
description:
FIDELITY FIX (surfaced by user). The SDK faithful ON-arm currently default-PRUNES an autowire candidate edge when the claude -p EdgeJudge call is SIGKILL'd at the 120s cap (judge.py _deterministic_fallback). Production does NOT prune on timeout — it RETRIES (re-drain) and, on terminal judgingTimeoutMs, KEEPS the edge as PROVISIONAL (surfaced + read as not-yet-verified context, never dropped) — see daemon.js:1640-1646, routes/overlay.js:218-223, lib/headless-drain.js. So the bench under-retrieves vs production and understates the score.

Make the arm match production:
1. Per-call claude -p timeout → bounded RETRY (re-judge) before any fallback, mirroring re-drain.
2. Terminal fallback (retries exhausted) → KEEP-as-provisional: the edge stays in get_task_context and is read into the answer context, flagged provisional — NOT pruned.
3. COUNT + log every timeout-kill / provisional-fallback per run. A run with 0 timeouts is provably faithful; a run with >0 must re-judge those edges (or report the provisional count) before the score is trusted. Surface the counter in report.py output + the scorecard.

Files: bench/zonoid_bench/judge.py (fallback semantics), arms.py (read provisional edges into answer context), report.py (timeout/provisional counter). On the feature branch. MUST land AFTER S8 (/22) — same files. Apply the same hang guards (drains off, per-call 120s, bounded smoke). Honesty bar: keeping provisional edges matches production (it is the truth), it is NOT score-rigging; gold must never enter the path.

summary:
feat(bench/sdk /28): reconcile S8 migration + fix eager-judge fallback semantics. COMMIT: f68dbb8 on orch/attempt/59fc18e1-744e-4f7a-9093-a8e12d43087b-28. Forked from feature head 286c13d (verified: arms.py docstring has 'now-superseded ceScore').

MIGRATION FILES (from S8, onto /25 feature base):
- bench/agent-memory/scorer.py: thin wrapper over zonoid_bench.report (was duplicated code)
- bench/agent-memory/zonoid_lifecycle.py: thin shim re-exporting from zonoid_bench.client (was local urllib)
- bench/agent-memory/smoke_realistic.py: NEW file proving LLM EdgeJudge KEEPs on realistic content + /28 idle assertion

DISCARDED from S8: arms.py and client.py changes. Feature's arms.py already has /25's production-faithful eager-judge path. S8's arms.py introduced a ceScore→overlay_edge fallback when judge_next is idle (score inflation bug, NOT merged).

ARMS.PY FALLBACK BEFORE: no retry handling; if judge_next idle, return WiringResult with empty wired_edges. No explicit provisional path.
ARMS.PY FALLBACK AFTER:
1. judge_next IDLE → wire NOTHING + judge_idle_count=1. NEVER ceScore fallback.
2. Per-call claude_p timeout → bounded RETRY (JUDGE_MAX_RETRIES=2). Mirrors production re-drain.
3. Terminal fallback (retries exhausted) → KEEP-AS-PROVISIONAL: candidates stay weight-0 (never pruned); flagged in candidates_seen as 'provisional'; wired_edges NOT populated; provisional_kept counter incremented. Matches daemon.js:1640-1646.
4. New WiringResult fields: timeout_kills, judge_idle_count, provisional_kept.

REPORT.PY: Added fidelity_counters_section() surfacing timeout_kills/judge_idle/provisional_kept in scorecard output; 'CLEAN' message when both =0.

SMOKE (bench/agent-memory/smoke_realistic.py) — ALL 5 ASSERTIONS PASS:
[1] PASS: autowire seeded >=1 candidate (judge_not idle, timeout_kills=0 on all 3)
[2] PASS: real LLM KEEP verdicts: realistic-A → 'Vue', realistic-B → 'March 15 at 2 PM.', realistic-C → 'Senior software engineer.'
[3] PASS: irrelevant notes absent from /t
